LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 11.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.3: Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we form words from other words? 2. Why are adverbs important in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. Identify adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences or a group of words,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. Form adverbs from adjectives,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. Use adverbs formed from adjectives in sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the value of adverbs in communication. ● In pairs, guide the learners to select adverbs formed from adjectives from a print or braille text and other non- print text. ● Guide the learners to read a text on careers and identify the adverbs used. ● In pairs, guide the learners to construct sentences on different careers using adverbs formed from adjectives. ● Guide the learners to select the correct forms of adverbs from a substitution table. ● Guide the learners to search for online newspapers or magazines and look for examples of adverbs formed from adjectives, learners with blindness to use digital devices with assistive technologies. 1. How do we form words from other words? 2. Why are adverbs important in communication? 126 ● Guide the learners to complete the blanks using adverbs formed from adjectives. ● In pairs, let the learners compile a list of instructions using adverbs formed from adjectives. ● Learners to make a list of adverbs formed from adjectives and display them on a chart for learners with low vision and braille charts for learners with blindness. ● Guide the learners to compose short poems using adverbs formed from adjectives.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner composes short poems using adverbs formed from adjectives.

● Critical thinking: The learner searches the internet, newspapers or magazine for examples of adverbs formed from

adjectives.
